sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: lane travel, speed, pavement markings and space cushion
Knowledge facts: part C holds 54 fact blocks (sec03-F01 onward) from physical pages 26 to 37; part C2 holds 18 confusable and continuation blocks (sec03-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 - 2027 manual, the 35-question count and the 28-of-35 passing standard from physical page 10; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- OR-LANE-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- OR-LANE-D-STOPCHART — stopping distance chart speeds not extractable (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- OR-LANE-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- OR-LANE-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: variable speed signs and interstate limits (for example sec03-F11, sec03-F13) change with conditions or segment and must be read from the posted sign; nothing else in these pages is time- or place-variable.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.
